meetings.title: Team Daily Meeting
meetings.content:
Summary Lead prioritization and student success frameworks for improving cash collection and tracking financial performance via revenue data. 

Lead Prioritization Strategy Engagement data from email campaigns guides lead prioritization using clicks and opens. Filtered opted-in contact lists identify high-interest leads for efficient calling.

 Student Success Management Student churn is reduced by tracking milestones and setting clear KPIs. Standardizing the onboarding process improves student progression and ensures payment completion. 

Financial Performance Review Collecting payments from existing clients on plans remains the primary focus. The team decided to urgently audit misleading revenue data to ensure accurate financial reporting.

1. Lead Prioritization
Prioritize leads based on engagement:
Clicks = highest priority
Opens = second priority
Use opt-in contact lists + tags to identify high-interest leads.
Focus on calling high-intent leads immediately for better conversion.

2. Student Success System
Build a structured onboarding process with clear steps and guidance.
Track student milestones (e.g., niche selection, outreach, bookings).
Define KPIs to reduce churn and ensure:
Progress
Payment completion
Testimonials collection
Introduce a progress timeline to guide students.

3. Cash Collection Focus
Top priority = collecting payments from existing clients (especially payment plans).
Partial-payment students require active follow-up and calls.
Closers must be involved in payment follow-ups.
Proactive tracking is key (follow up before due dates).

4. Financial Accuracy
Current revenue data is misleading (includes deposits only).
Urgent need to:
Clean and correct revenue tracking
Exclude deposits for accurate reporting
Align financial data with real cash flow

5. Key Operational Improvements
Standardize:
Lead tracking
Contact tagging
Onboarding documentation
Improve:
Campaign testing (avoid wasting budget)
Internal documentation and reporting
Explore certifications (e.g., KHDA/CDMA) for credibility.
Bottom Line

Focus on:

High-quality leads ÃÂ¢ÃÂÃÂ faster conversions
Strong student success system ÃÂ¢ÃÂÃÂ lower churn + full payments
Accurate financial tracking ÃÂ¢ÃÂÃÂ better decisions
Cash collection ÃÂ¢ÃÂÃÂ immediate revenue impact
